<thought>From the ^13C NMR data, methyl carbons appear in the upfield region (≈10‑35 ppm). Peaks at 34.53 ppm (appearing twice), 22.80 ppm, 21.35 ppm, and 19.20 ppm correspond to methyl carbons. Counting each methyl carbon gives 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 5 CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
